Date.now();\n  const root = scratchRoot();\n  const summary: ScratchGcSummary = {\n    retentionEvictions: 0,\n    retentionEvictedBytes: 0,\n    deadWorkspaces: 0,\n    deadWorkspaceBytes: 0,\n    quotaEvictions: 0,\n    quotaEvictedBytes: 0,\n    markersWritten: 0,\n    unprovenEntries: 0,\n    deadWorkspacesDeferred: [],\n  };\n\n  const registrySet = new Set(opts.workspaceRegistry);\n\n  // Backfill: every registered workspace root that exists gets its marker, so that once the\n  // workspace leaves the registry its root is provably ours. Never creates a root.\n  for (const workspaceId of opts.workspaceRegistry) {\n    let wsRoot: string;\n    try {\n      wsRoot = scratchRootForWorkspace(workspaceId);\n    } catch {\n      continue; // an id with no valid scratch shape has no scratch root\n    }\n    if (await writeMarkerIfAbsent(wsRoot, workspaceId)) summary.markersWritten += 1;\n  }\n\n  // Step 2 (before step 1 so we don't waste work on dead workspaces): remove PROVABLY dead\n  // workspace roots wholesale (WI-10006512). A missing root lists as empty.\n  const candidates: Array<{ workspaceId: string; dir: string; realDir: string; bytes: number }> = [];\n  for (const name of await listDir(root)) {\n    if (registrySet.has(name)) continue;\n    const dir = join(root, name);\n    if (!(await isProvenWorkspaceScratchRoot(dir, name))) {\n      summary.unprovenEntries += 1;\n      continue;\n    }\n    const tree = await treeStatsAsync(dir);\n    if (now - tree.newestMtimeMs < DEAD_WORKSPACE_QUIET_MS) {\n      summary.deadWorkspacesDeferred.push({ workspaceId: name, reason: 'recent-write' });\n      continue;\n    }\n    // /proc fd and cwd links name REAL paths, so the scan must be given the real path too.\n    let realDir: string;\n    try {\n      realDir = await realpathAsync(dir);\n    } catch {\n      continue; // vanished mid-sweep\n    }\n    candidates.push({ workspaceId: name, dir, realDir, bytes: tree.bytes });\n  }\n  if (candidates.length > 0) {\n    let scan: OpenWriterScan = { byPath: new Map(), complete: false };\n    try {\n      scan = await (opts.scanOpenPaths ?? defaultScanOpenPaths)(candidates.map((c) => c.realDir));\n    } catch {\n      /* no process evidence is not permission to delete */\n    }\n    for (const c of candidates) {\n      if (scan.byPath.get(c.realDir)?.length) {\n        summary.deadWorkspacesDeferred.push({ workspaceId: c.workspaceId, reason: 'open-writer' });\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (!scan.complete) {\n        summary.deadWorkspacesDeferred.push({ workspaceId: c.workspaceId, reason: 'process-scan-incomplete' });\n        continue;\n      }\n      await rmAsync(c.dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n      summary.deadWorkspaces += 1;\n      summary.deadWorkspaceBytes += c.bytes;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Step 1: retention sweep, per-workspace.\n  for (const workspaceId of opts.workspaceRegistry) {\n    for (const run of await runDirsOf(scratchRootForWorkspace(workspaceId))) {\n      if (now - run.mtimeMs > RETENTION_MS) {\n        const bytes = await sizeOfDirAsync(run.dir);\n        await rmAsync(run.dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n        summary.retentionEvictions += 1;\n        summary.retentionEvictedBytes += bytes;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: per-workspace quota check + FIFO eviction by mtime.\n  for (const workspaceId of opts.workspaceRegistry) {\n    const reclaimed = await evictWorkspaceQuota(workspaceId, () => WORKSPACE_QUOTA_BYTES);\n    summary.quotaEvictions += reclaimed.evictions;\n    summary.quotaEvictedBytes += reclaimed.bytes;\n  }\n\n  return summary;\n}\n\n/** Entry names of `dir`, or [] when it is missing or unreadable. Never blocks the event loop. */\nasync function listDir(\n  dir: string,\n  diagnostics?: ScratchQuotaRecoveryDiagnostics,\n): Promise<string[]> {\n  try {\n    return await measureScratchQuotaRecoveryOperation(\n      diagnostics,\n      'readdir',\n      () => readdirAsync(dir),\n    );\n  } catch {\n    return [];\n  }\n}\n\n/** Child DIRECTORIES of `dir` with their mtimes; files and entries that vanish mid-walk are skipped. */\nasync function childDirs(\n  dir: string,\n  diagnostics?: ScratchQuotaRecoveryDiagnostics,\n): Promise<Array<{ dir: string; mtimeMs: number }>> {\n  const out: Array<{ dir: string; mtimeMs: number }> = [];\n  for (const name of await listDir(dir, diagnostics)) {\n    const child = join(dir, name);\n    let st;\n    try {\n      st = await measureScratchQuotaRecoveryOperation(diagnostics, 'stat', () => statAsync(child));\n    } catch {\n      continue;\n    }\n    if (st.isDirectory()) out.push({ dir: child, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs });\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\n/** Every `<toolName>/<runId>/` run dir under a workspace root (empty when the root is missing). */\nasync function runDirsOf(\n"},{"type":"input_text","text":"== workflow =="},{"type":"input_text","text":"    maxRecoveryAttempts: 5,\n  }),\n);\nDBOS.registerScheduled(telemetryFlushWorkflow, { name: 'telemetryFlush', crontab: '0 0 * * * *' });\n\n// Daily 03:00 (SCRATCH_GC_CRONTAB — the schedule's single source, in scratch-gc.ts):\n// scratch-storage GC sweep (retention + dead-workspace + quota).\nasync function scratchGcTick(): Promise<void> {\n  if (!(await retentionEnabled(FLAGS.STORAGE_RETAIN_SCRATCH))) return;\n  await DBOS.runStep(\n    async () => {\n      const workspaceRegistry = readRegistry().workspaces.map((w) => w.id);\n      const s = await runScratchGc({ workspaceRegistry });\n      // WI-10006512: what the sweep deleted, what it deliberately kept, and how much unowned\n      // top-level scratch exists, so a surprising deletion (or growth) is visible in the log.\n      console.log(\n        `[scratch-gc] deadWorkspaces=${s.deadWorkspaces} (${s.deadWorkspaceBytes}B) ` +\n          `deferred=${s.deadWorkspacesDeferred.map((d) => `${d.workspaceId}:${d.reason}`).join(',') || 'none'} ` +\n          `unprovenEntries=${s.unprovenEntries} markersWritten=${s.markersWritten} ` +\n          `retentionEvictions=${s.retentionEvictions} quotaEvictions=${s.quotaEvictions}`,\n      );\n    },\n    { name: 'scratch-gc' },\n  );\n  // WI-10005187: the hooks' per-owner state in ~/.papercusp/locks-cache is the same\n  // class of agent-local ephemeral storage and had no GC at all (32k entries).\n  // Fail-soft: a sweep error is logged, never thrown into a workflow retry.\n  await DBOS.runStep(\n    async () => {\n      try {\n        const r = await runLocksCacheGc();\n        console.log(\n          `[locks-cache-gc] ${r.dir}: scanned=${r.scanned} removed=${r.removed} kept=${r.kept} skipped=${r.skipped}${r.error ? ` error=${r.error}` : ''}`,\n        );\n      } catch (err) {\n        console.warn(`[locks-cache-gc] sweep failed (non-fatal): ${(err as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    },\n    { name: 'locks-cache-gc' },\n  );\n}\nconst scratchGcWorkflow = idempotentRegisterWorkflow('scratchGc', () =>\n  DBOS.registerWorkflow(scratchGcTick, {\n    name: 'scratchGc',\n    maxRecoveryAttempts: 5,\n  }),\n);\nDBOS.registerScheduled(scratchGcWorkflow, { name: 'scratchGc', crontab: SCRATCH_GC_CRONTAB });\n\n// (The 6-hourly mem0 ephemeral-TTL sweep was removed — the `ephemeral` kind is\n// retired, so nothing carries expires_at; ephemeral state lives in coord now.\n"},{"type":"input_text","text":"== result-door-index =="},{"type":"input_text","text":""}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a12308-19a2-7631-a242-ca75f623c446","create_time":1791589866.21896}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

Has happened twice; both required manual `rm -rf`.\\n\\n**Why:** original Phase 1 (commit `2a2f3c95`) introduced IGNORE_PATTERNS without these self-exclusions. Fixed properly in commit `1a8d1f67` (2026-05-13): added self-exclude entries plus `assertSelfExclusionPolicy()` guard in `snapshot()` that reads the global policy back via `kopia policy show --global --json` and refuses to snapshot if `backups` is missing. The pre-snapshot hook writes the PG dump into `<workspaceRoot>/db-dumps/pg-embedded.sql.gz` *precisely so kopia versions it* — excluding it silently broke point-in-time DB restore. Only `backups`, `.restored`, `.broken-*`, `.rolled-back-*` are genuine self-exclusions (kopia repo + recovery scratch dirs). `db-dumps/hook.log` stays out via the separate `*.log` rule.\\n\\n**How to apply:** never remove `backups` / `.restored` / `.broken-*` / `.rolled-back-*` from `IGNORE_PATTERNS`, and never re-add `db-dumps`. The kopia policy is synced by `applyGlobalPolicy()`, which `ensureRepo()` runs on every path (incl. the warm/already-connected one as of `8f1109b2`) so settings changes propagate; it diffs via `diffPolicyIgnores()` and issues `--remove-ignore` for stale rules. If anyone reworks the layout so the repo is *outside* workspaceRoot, the guard can be relaxed. If size blows up again, first check whether `kopia policy show --global --json` actually contains `backups` in `files.ignore` for the affected workspace. {"timestamp":"2026-10-09T23:53:27.355Z","ordinal":714,"type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"custom_tool_call","id":"ctc_0b2a9f2157c1251d016ac97e750f0c8196a90a2cd9a1b77461","status":"completed","call_id":"call_18c58370e25e4cee95ae65fa0e7d55b5","name":"exec","input":"function decodeBase64(s) {\n  const alphabet=\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\";\n  const out=[]; let acc=0,bits=0;\n  for(const ch of s){if(ch===\"=\")break;const v=alphabet.indexOf(ch);if(v<0)throw new Error(\"invalid base64\");acc=(acc<<6)|v;bits+=6;if(bits>=8){bits-=8;out.push((acc>>bits)&255);}}\n  return Uint8Array.from(out);\n}\nconst uri=\"papercusp://scratch/papercusp-workspace/tools:invoke/08176c4c-8ace-4e87-97ae-a8a6c0b6ff1e/result-door-1791590001329-7084f60e.spill\";\nlet args={uri,byte_offset:0,byte_limit:4096};\nconst parts=[];let total=0;\nfor(let n=0;n<8;n++){\n const r=await tools.mcp__papercusp_su__tools_invoke({name:\"capability:read\",args});\n const d=JSON.parse(r.content.find(x=>x.type===\"text\").text);\n if(!d.ok||d.encoding!==\"base64\")throw new Error(JSON.stringify(d));\n parts.push(decodeBase64(d.data));total=d.total_bytes;\n if(d.eof)break;\n args=d.next_cursor.args;\n}\nconst all=new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.length,0));let off=0;\nfor(const p of parts){all.set(p,off);off+=p.length;}\nif(all.length!==total)throw new Error(`bytes mismatch ${all.length}/${total}`);\nlet bytes=\"\";for(let i=0;i<all.length;i+=8192)bytes+=String.fromCharCode(...all.subarray(i,i+8192));\nconst outer=JSON.parse(bytes);\nconst payload=JSON.parse(outer.content.find(x=>x.type===\"text\").text);\nconst cp=payload.results[0].checkpoint;\ntext(cp);\n","internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a12308-19a2-7631-a242-ca75f623c446","create_time":1791590005.0603247}}}

{"timestamp":"2026-10-09T23:54:02.745Z","ordinal":746,"type":"event_msg","payload":{"type":"item_completed","thread_id":"01a12308-16d4-7b32-8c56-c080e0f308f7","turn_id":"01a12308-19a2-7631-a242-ca75f623c446","item":{"type":"CommandExecution","id":"exec-fd1a36a0-56be-4bae-a28e-39e02b53c2cf","process_id":"86723","command":["/bin/bash","-lc","sed -n '180,260p' packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ops.ts && sed -n '180,305p' packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ports.ts"],"cwd":"file:///home/marsh-office/papercupai-workspace/papercusp","parsed_cmd":[{"type":"read","cmd":"sed -n '180,260p' packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ops.ts","name":"live-ops.ts","path":"packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ops.ts"},{"type":"read","cmd":"sed -n '180,305p' packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ports.ts","name":"live-ports.ts","path":"packages/operator-core/lib/pot-eval/live-ports.ts"}],"source":"unified_exec_startup","status":"completed","aggregated_output":"\n/**\n * The LIVE `readRunTrace` — gather the full {@link LiveRunCapture} BEFORE teardown removes the clone\n * + member schema: run the scenario's acceptance command in the clone, collect the ground truth\n * (b459e's `liveGroundTruthPortsFromSql` over the member's HFC/spawn rows) with the regression floor\n * (pre = the pristine seed-app fixture, post = the run's mutated clone), and read the confirmed spawn\n * rows. The capture rides `extra.capture` to the (post-teardown) replay extractor. NO LLM spend —\n * the only live cost is the drive that produced these rows.\n */\nexport async function captureRunData(\n  sql: postgres.Sql,\n  input: CaptureRunDataInput,\n): Promise<{ distilledTrace: string; traceRef: string; extra: Record<string, unknown> }> {\n  const { member, hiveHome, repoPath, scenario, workspaceId, maxChars } = input;\n  const ctx: GroundTruthCtx = { scenario, repoPath, potSlug: member, workspaceId };\n\n  const acceptance = await liveAcceptancePorts().runAcceptance({ repoPath, acceptance: scenario.acceptance });\n\n  const baseline = async () => {\n    const [pre, post] = await Promise.all([runBaselineSuite(SEED_APP_DIR), runBaselineSuite(repoPath)]);\n    return { pre, post };\n  };\n  const groundTruth = await collectGroundTruth(liveGroundTruthPortsFromSql({ sql, baseline }), ctx);\n\n  const spawnRows = await readMemberSpawnRows(sql, member, workspaceId);\n\n  // Per-wake Mug efficiency (B-06, scoped to the unique home slug, role='mug') + per-bee\n  // warm-inject carry (P-015, scoped to the member clone, role='bee' grouped by session_id) for THIS\n  // run. Both are non-LLM reads of already-persisted rows; each fail-soft (a read error leaves its\n  // half absent → those fields default to 0, the same conservative floor as the other EKG fields).\n  const [queenEkg, beeEkg] = await Promise.all([\n    readQueenEkg(sql, { workspaceId, hiveHome }).catch(() => undefined),\n    readBeeEkg(sql, { workspaceId, member }).catch(() => undefined),\n  ]);\n  const ekg: BehaviorEkgFields | undefined = queenEkg || beeEkg ? { ...queenEkg, ...beeEkg } : undefined;\n\n  const capture: LiveRunCapture = { acceptance, groundTruth, spawnRows, ...(ekg ? { ekg } : {}) };\n\n  // A compact human-readable trace for the (optional, advisory) HE-06 judge — capped at maxChars.\n  const claimed = groundTruth.workItems.filter((w) => w.claimedDone).length;\n  const real = groundTruth.workItems.filter((w) => w.actuallyDone && w.hasCommit).length;\n  const trace =\n    `Scenario ${scenario.id} (${scenario.shape}) — acceptance ${acceptance.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}; ` +\n    `${claimed} claimed done / ${real} genuinely done (commit+work); ${spawnRows.length} bee spawns. ` +\n    `Review:\\n${groundTruth.reviewOutput}`;\n  const distilledTrace = trace.slice(0, maxChars);\n\n  return { distilledTrace, traceRef: `hive-eval://${member}`, extra: packLiveRunCapture(capture) };\n}\n\nexport interface LiveHiveOpsDeps {\n  workspaceId: string;\n  /** Per-run scratch parent dir (the base + clone live under it). Default `os.tmpdir()/hive-eval`. */\n  scratchParent?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Bind the concrete {@link LiveHiveOps} for a workspace. Every IO op the orchestration calls is a\n * real seam here; `makeLiveHivePorts(liveHiveOps({ workspaceId }), { workspaceId })` is the live\n * `HiveRunPorts` the cadence runs once the owner sets a budget (P-051).\n */\nexport function liveHiveOps(deps: LiveHiveOpsDeps): LiveHiveOps {\n  const ws = deps.workspaceId;\n  const scratchParent = deps.scratchParent ?? join(tmpdir(), 'pot-eval');\n  const sqlClient = (): postgres.Sql => getOrgPg().sql;\n\n  return {\n    scratchRoot: (slug) => join(scratchParent, slug),\n    copyDir: (src, dest) => cp(src, dest, { recursive: true }),\n    exec: async (cmd, args) => {\n      const { stdout } = await execFileP(cmd, args, { maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024 });\n      return { stdout };\n    },\n    rm: (path) => rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }),\n\n    async createHive({ slug, workspaceId }) {\n      // Idle (no wakeInSeconds — driveToCompletion starts it), repo-less, no knowledge-pack seed.\n      const res = await createPotHarness({ slug, workspaceId, knowledgePack: null });\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        throw new Error(`hive-eval createHive('${slug}') failed: ${res.error ?? 'unknown'} ${res.message ?? ''}`.trim());\n      }\nexport interface LiveHivePortsOpts {\n  workspaceId: string;\n  /** Poll cadence for the drained check during driveToCompletion. Default 10s. */\n  pollIntervalMs?: number;\n}\n\n/** The boot context threaded (opaquely) to seed/drive/collect/teardown. */\ninterface LiveBootHandle {\n  home: string;\n  member: string;\n  base: string;\n  clone: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Assemble the LIVE {@link HiveRunPorts} from the injected ops. boot → materialize+clone the\n * seed-app, mint the Queen seat + register the substrate member; seed → the work-item DAG + block\n * edges; drive → start the Hive then poll until {@link isHiveDrained} or the timeout (then pause to\n * bound spend); collect → the distilled trace; teardown → drop the member + dissolve the hive +\n * remove the clones. The whole-Hive run is real LLM spend — reached only by an owner-armed run.\n */\nexport function makeLiveHivePorts(ops: LiveHiveOps, opts: LiveHivePortsOpts): HiveRunPorts {\n  const ws = opts.workspaceId;\n  const pollIntervalMs = opts.pollIntervalMs ?? 10_000;\n\n  return {\n    now: () => ops.now(),\n\n    async bootHive({ identity }): Promise<HiveBootResult> {\n      const root = ops.scratchRoot(identity.potSlug);\n      const base = `${root}/base`;\n      const clone = `${root}/clone`;\n      const home = identity.potSlug;\n      const member = `${identity.potSlug}m`; // hyphen-free (run-identity) ⇒ safe schema id\n\n      // 1. Materialize the seed-app fixture as a one-commit repo (the clone source + pin).\n      await ops.copyDir(SEED_APP_DIR, base);\n      for (const c of seedRepoMaterializeCommands(base)) await ops.exec(c.argv[0], c.argv.slice(1));\n      const sha = (await ops.exec('git', ['-C', base, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])).stdout.trim();\n      // 2. Hermetic-clone @ the pinned SHA.\n      for (const c of seedRepoCloneCommands({ baseDir: base, commit: sha, destDir: clone })) {\n        await ops.exec(c.argv[0], c.argv.slice(1));\n      }\n      // 3. Queen seat (idle) + the substrate as a member harness it surveys.\n      await ops.createHive({ slug: home, workspaceId: ws });\n      await ops.registerMember({ member, clonePath: clone, hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws });\n\n      const handle: LiveBootHandle = { home, member, base, clone };\n      return { potSlug: home, repoPath: clone, workspaceId: ws, handle };\n    },\n\n    async seedScenario({ scenario, boot }): Promise<void> {\n      const { member } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      const plan = scenarioSeedPlan(scenario);\n      for (const f of plan.features) {\n        await ops.seedFeature({ member, featureId: f.featureId, title: f.title, spec: f.spec, workspaceId: ws });\n      }\n      // Block edges per work-item (the planted defect is already in the cloned repo).\n      for (const w of scenario.workItems) {\n        if (w.dependsOn.length > 0) await ops.syncBlockEdges({ member, featureId: w.id, blockedBy: w.dependsOn });\n      }\n    },\n\n    async driveToCompletion({ scenario, boot, timeoutMs }): Promise<DriveResult> {\n      const { home, member } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      const startedAt = ops.now();\n      await ops.startHive({\n        hiveHome: home,\n        workspaceId: ws,\n        kickoff: `Hive-eval scenario \"${scenario.id}\" — drain the seeded work-items to the known-good end state.`,\n      });\n\n      let drained = false;\n      try {\n        while (ops.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {\n          const [survey, inFlight] = await Promise.all([\n            ops.survey({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }),\n            ops.countInFlightPlacements({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }),\n          ]);\n          if (isHiveDrained(survey, inFlight)) {\n            drained = true;\n            break;\n          }\n          await ops.sleep(pollIntervalMs);\n        }\n      } finally {\n        // Always stop the Hive — a timed-out run must not keep spending.\n        await ops.pauseHive({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      }\n\n      const stats = await ops.readRunStats({ member, workspaceId: ws });\n      return {\n        terminalState: drained ? 'drained' : 'timeout',\n        frontierDrained: drained,\n        workItemsTotal: stats.workItemsTotal || scenario.workItems.length,\n        workItemsCompleted: stats.workItemsCompleted,\n        costUsd: stats.costUsd,\n      };\n    },\n\n    async collectRunData({ scenario, boot, maxChars }) {\n      const { member, home } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      // Capture EVERYTHING live here (acceptance over the clone + ground-truth rows + spawn\n      // behavior/timing + the Queen per-wake efficiency scoped to the home) — teardown runs\n      // immediately after, so the extractor replays from `extra`.\n      return ops.readRunTrace({ member, hiveHome: home, repoPath: boot.repoPath, scenario, workspaceId: ws, maxChars });\n    },\n\n    async teardown({ boot }): Promise<void> {\n      const { home, member, base, clone } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      await ops.dropMember({ member, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.dissolveHive({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.rm(base).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.rm(clone).catch(() => {});\n    },\n  };\n}\n","exit_code":0,"duration":{"secs":0,"nanos":27032}},"started_at_ms":1791590042745,"completed_at_ms":1791590042745}}

The capture rides `extra.capture` to the (post-teardown) replay extractor. NO LLM spend —\n * the only live cost is the drive that produced these rows.\n */\nexport async function captureRunData(\n  sql: postgres.Sql,\n  input: CaptureRunDataInput,\n): Promise<{ distilledTrace: string; traceRef: string; extra: Record<string, unknown> }> {\n  const { member, hiveHome, repoPath, scenario, workspaceId, maxChars } = input;\n  const ctx: GroundTruthCtx = { scenario, repoPath, potSlug: member, workspaceId };\n\n  const acceptance = await liveAcceptancePorts().runAcceptance({ repoPath, acceptance: scenario.acceptance });\n\n  const baseline = async () => {\n    const [pre, post] = await Promise.all([runBaselineSuite(SEED_APP_DIR), runBaselineSuite(repoPath)]);\n    return { pre, post };\n  };\n  const groundTruth = await collectGroundTruth(liveGroundTruthPortsFromSql({ sql, baseline }), ctx);\n\n  const spawnRows = await readMemberSpawnRows(sql, member, workspaceId);\n\n  // Per-wake Mug efficiency (B-06, scoped to the unique home slug, role='mug') + per-bee\n  // warm-inject carry (P-015, scoped to the member clone, role='bee' grouped by session_id) for THIS\n  // run. Both are non-LLM reads of already-persisted rows; each fail-soft (a read error leaves its\n  // half absent → those fields default to 0, the same conservative floor as the other EKG fields).\n  const [queenEkg, beeEkg] = await Promise.all([\n    readQueenEkg(sql, { workspaceId, hiveHome }).catch(() => undefined),\n    readBeeEkg(sql, { workspaceId, member }).catch(() => undefined),\n  ]);\n  const ekg: BehaviorEkgFields | undefined = queenEkg || beeEkg ? { ...queenEkg, ...beeEkg } : undefined;\n\n  const capture: LiveRunCapture = { acceptance, groundTruth, spawnRows, ...(ekg ? { ekg } : {}) };\n\n  // A compact human-readable trace for the (optional, advisory) HE-06 judge — capped at maxChars.\n  const claimed = groundTruth.workItems.filter((w) => w.claimedDone).length;\n  const real = groundTruth.workItems.filter((w) => w.actuallyDone && w.hasCommit).length;\n  const trace =\n    `Scenario ${scenario.id} (${scenario.shape}) — acceptance ${acceptance.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}; ` +\n    `${claimed} claimed done / ${real} genuinely done (commit+work); ${spawnRows.length} bee spawns. ` +\n    `Review:\\n${groundTruth.reviewOutput}`;\n  const distilledTrace = trace.slice(0, maxChars);\n\n  return { distilledTrace, traceRef: `hive-eval://${member}`, extra: packLiveRunCapture(capture) };\n}\n\nexport interface LiveHiveOpsDeps {\n  workspaceId: string;\n  /** Per-run scratch parent dir (the base + clone live under it). Default `os.tmpdir()/hive-eval`. */\n  scratchParent?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Bind the concrete {@link LiveHiveOps} for a workspace. Every IO op the orchestration calls is a\n * real seam here; `makeLiveHivePorts(liveHiveOps({ workspaceId }), { workspaceId })` is the live\n * `HiveRunPorts` the cadence runs once the owner sets a budget (P-051).\n */\nexport function liveHiveOps(deps: LiveHiveOpsDeps): LiveHiveOps {\n  const ws = deps.workspaceId;\n  const scratchParent = deps.scratchParent ?? join(tmpdir(), 'pot-eval');\n  const sqlClient = (): postgres.Sql => getOrgPg().sql;\n\n  return {\n    scratchRoot: (slug) => join(scratchParent, slug),\n    copyDir: (src, dest) => cp(src, dest, { recursive: true }),\n    exec: async (cmd, args) => {\n      const { stdout } = await execFileP(cmd, args, { maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024 });\n      return { stdout };\n    },\n    rm: (path) => rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }),\n\n    async createHive({ slug, workspaceId }) {\n      // Idle (no wakeInSeconds — driveToCompletion starts it), repo-less, no knowledge-pack seed.\n      const res = await createPotHarness({ slug, workspaceId, knowledgePack: null });\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        throw new Error(`hive-eval createHive('${slug}') failed: ${res.error ?? 'unknown'} ${res.message ?? ''}`.trim());\n      }\nexport interface LiveHivePortsOpts {\n  workspaceId: string;\n  /** Poll cadence for the drained check during driveToCompletion. Default 10s. */\n  pollIntervalMs?: number;\n}\n\n/** The boot context threaded (opaquely) to seed/drive/collect/teardown. */\ninterface LiveBootHandle {\n  home: string;\n  member: string;\n  base: string;\n  clone: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Assemble the LIVE {@link HiveRunPorts} from the injected ops. boot → materialize+clone the\n * seed-app, mint the Queen seat + register the substrate member; seed → the work-item DAG + block\n * edges; drive → start the Hive then poll until {@link isHiveDrained} or the timeout (then pause to\n * bound spend); collect → the distilled trace; teardown → drop the member + dissolve the hive +\n * remove the clones. The whole-Hive run is real LLM spend — reached only by an owner-armed run.\n */\nexport function makeLiveHivePorts(ops: LiveHiveOps, opts: LiveHivePortsOpts): HiveRunPorts {\n  const ws = opts.workspaceId;\n  const pollIntervalMs = opts.pollIntervalMs ?? 10_000;\n\n  return {\n    now: () => ops.now(),\n\n    async bootHive({ identity }): Promise<HiveBootResult> {\n      const root = ops.scratchRoot(identity.potSlug);\n      const base = `${root}/base`;\n      const clone = `${root}/clone`;\n      const home = identity.potSlug;\n      const member = `${identity.potSlug}m`; // hyphen-free (run-identity) ⇒ safe schema id\n\n      // 1. Materialize the seed-app fixture as a one-commit repo (the clone source + pin).\n      await ops.copyDir(SEED_APP_DIR, base);\n      for (const c of seedRepoMaterializeCommands(base)) await ops.exec(c.argv[0], c.argv.slice(1));\n      const sha = (await ops.exec('git', ['-C', base, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])).stdout.trim();\n      // 2. Hermetic-clone @ the pinned SHA.\n      for (const c of seedRepoCloneCommands({ baseDir: base, commit: sha, destDir: clone })) {\n        await ops.exec(c.argv[0], c.argv.slice(1));\n      }\n      // 3. Queen seat (idle) + the substrate as a member harness it surveys.\n      await ops.createHive({ slug: home, workspaceId: ws });\n      await ops.registerMember({ member, clonePath: clone, hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws });\n\n      const handle: LiveBootHandle = { home, member, base, clone };\n      return { potSlug: home, repoPath: clone, workspaceId: ws, handle };\n    },\n\n    async seedScenario({ scenario, boot }): Promise<void> {\n      const { member } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      const plan = scenarioSeedPlan(scenario);\n      for (const f of plan.features) {\n        await ops.seedFeature({ member, featureId: f.featureId, title: f.title, spec: f.spec, workspaceId: ws });\n      }\n      // Block edges per work-item (the planted defect is already in the cloned repo).\n      for (const w of scenario.workItems) {\n        if (w.dependsOn.length > 0) await ops.syncBlockEdges({ member, featureId: w.id, blockedBy: w.dependsOn });\n      }\n    },\n\n    async driveToCompletion({ scenario, boot, timeoutMs }): Promise<DriveResult> {\n      const { home, member } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      const startedAt = ops.now();\n      await ops.startHive({\n        hiveHome: home,\n        workspaceId: ws,\n        kickoff: `Hive-eval scenario \"${scenario.id}\" — drain the seeded work-items to the known-good end state.`,\n      });\n\n      let drained = false;\n      try {\n        while (ops.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {\n          const [survey, inFlight] = await Promise.all([\n            ops.survey({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }),\n            ops.countInFlightPlacements({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }),\n          ]);\n          if (isHiveDrained(survey, inFlight)) {\n            drained = true;\n            break;\n          }\n          await ops.sleep(pollIntervalMs);\n        }\n      } finally {\n        // Always stop the Hive — a timed-out run must not keep spending.\n        await ops.pauseHive({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      }\n\n      const stats = await ops.readRunStats({ member, workspaceId: ws });\n      return {\n        terminalState: drained ? 'drained' : 'timeout',\n        frontierDrained: drained,\n        workItemsTotal: stats.workItemsTotal || scenario.workItems.length,\n        workItemsCompleted: stats.workItemsCompleted,\n        costUsd: stats.costUsd,\n      };\n    },\n\n    async collectRunData({ scenario, boot, maxChars }) {\n      const { member, home } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      // Capture EVERYTHING live here (acceptance over the clone + ground-truth rows + spawn\n      // behavior/timing + the Queen per-wake efficiency scoped to the home) — teardown runs\n      // immediately after, so the extractor replays from `extra`.\n      return ops.readRunTrace({ member, hiveHome: home, repoPath: boot.repoPath, scenario, workspaceId: ws, maxChars });\n    },\n\n    async teardown({ boot }): Promise<void> {\n      const { home, member, base, clone } = boot.handle as LiveBootHandle;\n      await ops.dropMember({ member, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.dissolveHive({ hiveHome: home, workspaceId: ws }).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.rm(base).catch(() => {});\n      await ops.rm(clone).catch(() => {});\n    },\n  };\n}\n"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a12308-19a2-7631-a242-ca75f623c446","create_time":1791590043.2195835}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}
